title: Bounds on the Number of Modes of a Gaussian Mixture Density
summary: We derive explicit upper bounds for the number of nondegenerate critical points of a $k$-component Gaussian mixture density in $\mathbb{R}^d$, and the number of modes when the modal set is finite, together with lower bounds.
